response.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A line contributes to the invoice ratio only when both cost values are present; the line-item count includes every row for the invoice.

alternatives.interpretation: Ignore missing product and total costs independently when summing each invoice.
